About Company:

Based in Houston, Taurus Industrial Group (Taurus) is a leading, integrated and industry-diversified technical services company offering end-to-end services across multiple service lines. Leveraging a growing footprint with operations in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, Taurus’s service offerings cover engineering and automation, electrical and instrumentation, power systems testing and commissioning, civil and mechanical crafts, pipe and structural steel fabrication, rotating equipment maintenance and repairs, full-service soft crafts, insulation and scaffold, specialty tooling and machining, technical bolting, heat treating, hot-tapping, line stopping and NDT / inspections.

With over 60 years of continuous, safe, and reliable operating experience, Taurus operates across multiple industries and sectors, providing front-end engineering, routine maintenance, capital projects, and turnaround services. We service multiple areas of the energy industry, from our origins in traditional petrochemical and refining industries to the broader power, natural gas, midstream, industrials, and the emerging renewables market.

Location: Rosenburg, TX

About the Role:

The E&I Construction Manager  will play a critical role in overseeing the electrical and instrumentation aspects of our projects, ensuring that all work is completed to the highest standards of safety and quality. This position requires a strong leader who can effectively manage teams, coordinate with various stakeholders, and ensure compliance with industry regulations. The Superintendent will be responsible for developing project schedules, monitoring progress, and implementing corrective actions as necessary to meet deadlines. Additionally, this role involves mentoring and training junior staff, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and safety awareness. Ultimately, the Superintendent will contribute to the successful completion of projects, enhancing our reputation in the industry and ensuring client satisfaction.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical and instrumentation project management.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing large-scale projects in the construction or industrial sector.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with project management software and tools.
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to electrical and instrumentation work.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee daily operations of electrical and instrumentation projects, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • Develop and manage project schedules, budgets, and resource allocation to meet project goals.
  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to ensure seamless project execution.
  • Conduct regular site inspections and audits to monitor compliance with safety regulations and project specifications.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to team members, promoting professional development and a culture of safety.

Skills:

The required skills for this role include strong leadership and communication abilities, which are essential for managing teams and liaising with stakeholders. Technical expertise in electrical and instrumentation systems is crucial for making informed decisions and ensuring project compliance. Problem-solving skills will be utilized daily to address challenges that arise during project execution, while organizational skills will help in managing multiple tasks and deadlines effectively. Preferred skills, such as proficiency in project management software, will enhance efficiency in tracking project progress and resource allocation. Overall, a combination of technical knowledge and interpersonal skills will enable the Superintendent to lead projects successfully and foster a collaborative work environment.
